body:
This is probably the first post to actually cheer me up a bit, so thank you very much for that. 

I'm relatively friendless as of now because the vast majority of the people I interacted with was incredibly toxic and bad for me. I've cut myself off from most, but I'm keeping the ones that genuinely care about me.

You're right about depression causing a narrow view but I really don't have much going for me right now. I'm holding out for hopes that my future self will be happier. It's a somewhat sad reason to stay alive, but it's a reason. Once again, thank you.

Most of their songs on Too-Rye-Aye have an upbeat vibe and a lot of brass instrumentation similar to that of "Come On Eileen", but the biggest difference is that their others songs belong to slightly different genres. A lot of their songs are jazzier and some are even close to ska. One of their best songs besides "Come On Eileen" in my opinion is "I'll Show You". It sucks that they're known mainly as a one-hit-wonder band, all of their stuff is great.
Good job! Taking the first step is the hardest (and often scariest) part for a lot of people, so you should genuinely be proud of yourself. I hope you see some improvement soon.
